title: Cryogenic Focused Ion Beam Preparation of Organic-Inorganic Hybrid Perovskite FAPbI3 for Transmission Electron Microscopy
content: Transmission electron microscopy (TEM) plays a crucial role in investigating the structure-property relationships in organic-inorganic hybrid perovskites (OIHPs) [1-3], providing structural insights into critical questions such as the origin of their exceptional photovoltaic performance [4] and the nature of their inherent instability [5].
